chapters.title: Chapter 1: Study as If You Were Going to Live Forever; Live as If You Were Going to Die Tomorrow. — Maria Mitchell Pisa, Kingdom of Sardinia— 1891
Chapter 2: It Had Long Since Come to My Attention That People of Accomplishment Rarely Sat Back and Let Things Happen to Them. They Went Out and Happened to Things. — Leonardo Da Vinci
Chapter 3: Scientists Delight Not in Abundance of Material; They Rejoice only In the Excellence of Their Experimental Methods. — Jabir Ibn Hayyan

Chapter 4: Ah, Child and Youth, if You Knew the Bliss Which Resides in The Taste of Knowledge, and The Evil and Ugliness that Lies in Ignorance, how Well You Are Advised to Not Complain of The Pain and Labor of Learning. — Christine De Pizan Porzia
Chapter 5: One of the Most Beautiful Qualities of True Friendship Is to Understand and to Be Understood. — Lucius Annaeus Seneca
Chapter 6: Self-Love Always the Mainspring, More or Less Concealed, of Our Actions; It Is the Wind Which Swells the Sails, without Which the Ship Could Not Go. — Émilie Du Châtelet
Chapter 7: There Is in Every One of Us, Even Those Who Seem to Be Most Moderate, a Type of Desire that Is Terrible, Wild, and Lawless. — Plato
Chapter 8: I Had Rather Die in the Adventure of Noble Achievements, than Live in Obscure and Sluggish Security. — Margaret Cavendish
Chapter 9: Science Is Made Up of Mistakes, but They Are Mistakes Which It Is Useful to Make, Because They Lead Little by Little to the Truth. — Jules Verne
Chapter 10: Never Was Anything Great Achieved without Danger. — Niccolo Machiavelli
Chapter 11: Every Day Is a Journey, and the Journey Itself Is Home. — Matsuo Basho
Chapter 12: I Do Not Believe That This Woman Easily Finds Her Equal in The Science in Which She Excels. — Gottfried Liebniz, Regarding Maria Kirchin
Chapter 13: The Life so Short, the Craft so Long to Learn. — Hippocrates
Chapter 14: She Knows Too Much for Me. — Charles De Brosses
Chapter 15: Life Is a Shipwreck, but We Must Not Forget to Sing in The Lifeboats. — Voltaire
Chapter 16: There Was a Door to Which I Found No Key There Was the Veil Through Which I Could Not See — Omar Khayyam
Chapter 17: Being Deeply Loved by Someone Gives You Strength, While Loving Someone Deeply Gives You Courage. — Lao Tzu
Chapter 18: To Understand Is to Forgive. — Blaise Pascal
Chapter 19: It Is Not Always the Same Thing to Be a Good Man and A Good Citizen. — Aristotle
Chapter 20: You Ask Me What Forces Me to Speak? A Strange Thing; My Conscience. — Victor Hugo
Chapter 21: In God’s Name I Have Recorded the Weather Daily and With Diligent Attention, and In Order to See from Which Aspects the Changes of Weather May Come. — Maria Margaretha Kirchin
Chapter 22: Every Day We Are Changing, Every Day We Are Dying, and Yet We Fancy Ourselves Eternal. — St. Jerome
Chapter 23:I Did What He Commanded Me. I Was a Mere Tool Which He Had the Trouble of Sharpening. — Caroline Herschel
Chapter 24: The Hottest Places in Hell Are Reserved for Those Who, in Times of Great Moral Crisis, Maintain Their Neutrality. — Dante Alighieri

chapters.title: Chapter 1: I run. I’m slower than a herd of turtles stampeding through peanut butter. But I run. (Juniper - Three Years Later)
Chapter 2: That awkward moment when you’re wearing Nikes and you can’t do it. (Troy)
Chapter 3: One day I’ll do amazing things. Today I’ll be satisfied if I manage to not spill food on my boobs. (Juniper)
Chapter 4: Sunday carbs don’t count. Those are the Lord’s carbs and He wants you to be happy. (Troy)
Chapter 5: When I train legs, I make them my bitch for an hour... Then for the next two days they make me theirs. (Juniper)
Chapter 6: All I want is food, cuddles, attention, and exercise. I’m basically a puppy. (Troy)
Chapter 7: If we’re not meant to have midnight snacks, why is there a light in the fridge? (Juniper)
Chapter 8: If Instagramming gym selfies helps you reach your goals, don’t ever let anyone stop you. (Troy)
Chapter 9: Just saw three people jog outside and it inspired me to get up and close the blinds. (Juniper)
Chapter 10: I just saw some idiot at the gym put a water bottle in the Pringles holder on the treadmill. (Troy)
Chapter 11: My heart says chocolate and wine but my jeans say, for the love of God woman, eat a salad. (Juniper)
Chapter 12: One time I was late to practice and coach made me run laps. My dad was the coach. And he drove me to practice. (Troy)
Chapter 13: Alexa, do my cardio session for me. (Juniper)
Chapter 14: You never realize how long a minute is until you exercise. (Troy)
Chapter 15: I could simmer down but I like myself better when I’m all feisty and shit. (Juniper)
Chapter 16: Some people should use a glue stick instead of chapstick. (Troy)
Chapter 17: Some people call me crazy. I prefer happy with a twist. (Juniper)
Chapter 18: Life is not a fairytale. If you lose a shoe at midnight, you’re drunk. (Troy)
Chapter 19: Instructors who say “last one” are the reason I have trust issues. (Juniper)
Chapter 20: I bet it’s called almond milk because no one can say nut juice with a straight face. (Troy)
Chapter 21: Torn between looking like a snack and eating one. (Juniper)
Chapter 22: Today I will be as useless as the "g" in lasagna. (Troy)
Chapter 23: I put my bathroom scale in the corner and that’s where it can stay until it apologizes. (Juniper)
Chapter 24: Fit[ish]: semi fit; kind of fit; someone who likes the idea of being fit but equally likes food (Troy)
